aboutMainDesc: Official dealer Azimut Varshavka offers a wide selection of cars of various colors and trim levels on the most favorable terms. Over two hundred new and used cars are presented on the showroom territory. Among the assortment presented, you will find the most popular models of European, Asian, and Russian production. Complete personal consultation is provided for every client regarding any presented vehicle. You can learn more about models available from our managers or on our website.
aboutChooseText: By choosing Azimut Varshavka dealership you get:
aboutAdv1: the best prices on cars in Moscow;
aboutAdv2: a choice of cars from over two hundred models of various colors and specifications;
aboutAdv3: purchase of used cars that have undergone pre-sale preparation and legal verification;
aboutAdv5: high level of service and personalized approach;
aboutAdv6: profitable car purchase through Trade-in and recycling programs;
aboutAdv7: cooperation with the largest banks in Moscow offering the most favorable credit terms;
aboutAdv8: opportunity to participate in subsidized loan programs 'Family Car' and 'First Car', as well as special conditions for medical workers and those trading in their car as a down payment;
aboutAdv9: promotions and gifts from the dealership upon car purchase.
aboutFooter1: All questions regarding availability, colors, and equipment, as well as dealership operation, can always be clarified by phone listed on the website or via the contact form.
aboutFooter2: We value every client and guarantee a high level of service!
aboutSlogan: Azimut Varshavka — conquer all directions with us!
techMainDesc: Our auto service specialists have extensive experience in servicing vehicles of various manufacturers, both new and used, and can quickly detect and fix any malfunction. All work is performed in accordance with manufacturer recommendations.
techBodyRepairDesc: Modern equipment allows us to carry out body repairs of any complexity. We work only with high-quality materials from trusted suppliers.
techLocksmithRepairDesc: We perform both routine and major mechanical repairs, including power unit maintenance.
techTireServiceDesc: Timely tire replacement is essential for safe driving. We consider mileage, tire condition, and seasonality.
techDiagnosticsDesc: High-quality diagnostics helps identify existing problems and prevent potential ones, which is why the procedure is carried out regularly.
techOilChangeDesc: This is a necessary procedure that significantly increases engine life and helps minimize the negative effects of low-quality fuel.
techMaintenanceDesc: This ensures uninterrupted operation of the main vehicle components and assemblies.
techAlignmentDesc: The procedure ensures vehicle stability on the road. It is performed as planned or due to handling issues.
techPartsSelectionDesc: Car reliability directly depends on the quality of parts. This service allows selecting a high-quality part suitable for a specific vehicle.
techInsuranceRenewalDesc: We will select a reliable company offering insurance at fair prices, helping you avoid fraudulent schemes.
reviewText: «I am at the ALTERA dealership, I recommend it to everyone, great team, kind people, welcoming, this is not a scam, 100% guarantee for sure, directly from me, come on over! We came to buy a car at the ALTERA showroom...»
aboutShortDesc: We have a huge retail space of over 5000 square meters, with at least 200 domestic and foreign cars in stock. The staff of the 'Altera' dealership consists of true professionals who know the features of each specific car.
